notes: Annual 2023 figures for Chennai district, pulled from OpenCity-hosted Tamil Nadu Police CSVs (no 2024/2025 published yet at scrape time). Categories mapped to CrimeRadar taxonomy: assault = Assault on Women + Murder; sexual_offence = Rape + Attempt; harassment = Outraging Modesty + Sexual Harassment + Stalking. Theft / robbery / kidnapping / burglary are not present in the women-crime CSV.
